stem: Which examination finding would make a midline dermoid cyst less likely?

options.text: It is located in the submental area
It moves with tongue protrusion or swallowing
It is attached to the hyoid bone

explanation: Movement with tongue protrusion or swallowing makes a midline dermoid cyst less likely. Dermoid cysts are typically non-mobile with these manoeuvres, so movement suggests another diagnosis.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because a submental location is compatible with a midline dermoid cyst.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a soft, fluctuant mass is a typical clinical feature of a dermoid cyst.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a yellowish appearance is consistent with a dermoid cyst.
optionExplanations.D: Correct because a midline dermoid cyst should not move with tongue protrusion or swallowing; mobility on these manoeuvres suggests a different lesion.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because attachment to the hyoid bone is more suggestive of a thyroglossal duct cyst than a dermoid cyst.
